description: Input schema for Grok Imagine Video 1.5.

prompt.description: What happens in the video: subject, motion and camera. With reference images, refer to them as <IMAGE_0>, <IMAGE_1>, ...
examples: A red fox trots through fresh snow at dawn, slow tracking shot
prompt.title: Prompt

image.description: Optional first frame. The video animates from this image and keeps its aspect ratio unless aspect_ratio is set.
image.title: Image

reference_images.description: Optional reference images for characters, objects or style. Reference-to-video supports up to 720p.
reference_images.title: Reference Images

resolution.description: Output resolution. Price per second: 480p $0.08, 720p $0.14, 1080p $0.25. 1080p is not available with reference images.
resolution.title: Resolution

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio. Defaults to the first frame's ratio, or 16:9 without one. Setting it with a first frame stretches the image.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

generate_audio.description: Generate an audio track with the video.
generate_audio.title: Generate Audio

title: AppInput
